note: The High Maven cache path into `release.yml` was judged overstated: its writers are pushes and schedules, Medium at most; the High `samuelmeuli/action-maven-publish@v1` path holds at High for its four secrets and the Maven publish, with no push (read-only default, run log). Corrected after reading the workflows: the assessment named only insiders as writers, but a push or dispatch run whose job is entered through an unauthorized mutable action (a High dependency path of the same repository) also writes the default-branch cache the release restores, so the cache path holds at the High ceiling of that writer, not at Medium. No job here declares cache-mode, so GitHub keeps the cache of every low-trust run read-only and grants no job cache write: ISSUE-705 is silent and no cache path exists, so the cache ceiling admits none.
